decisions.decision: Fixed 5 real deployment bugs found during live verification, all merged to main this session, rather than deferring them
decisions.rationale: Each one directly blocked completing Phase 9's live-verification checkpoint: (1) worker container's compose bind-mount path broken by the 09-03 directory restructuring (fff4eac); (2) wizard.py container-mode host/cmkadmin prompt defaults + CMK_PASSWORD on the worker service, quick task 260907-lwe; (3) CheckmkConnection/bootstrap helpers had no port support at all, needed for the containerized Checkmk image's port 5000, quick task 260907-m8w; (4) activate_changes never passed force_foreign_changes=True, causing a recurring 401 first seen in an unrelated much-earlier session, quick task 260907-mp2; (5) checkmk container lacked CAP_NET_RAW for check_icmp (RC 126) plus the host's net.ipv4.ping_group_range sysctl blocking rootless Podman's ICMP relay (ba45197 + docs quick task 260907-nde)
